map.交货（准时率/次品率）统计 使用指南: Delivery (On-Time Rate/Defect Rate) Statistics User Guide
map.按交期与到货质量计算准时率与次品率，分供应商或时段汇总，用于供应链绩效评估，纯前: Compute on-time and defect rates from lead time and incoming quality, aggregated by supplier or period, for supply chain performance assessment — pure front-end statistics.
map.汇总各批次交货周期的实测天数，用均值/标准差看整体交期水平与稳定性，识别异常长交: Aggregate actual delivery days per batch and use the mean and standard deviation to see the overall lead-time level and stability, identifying unusually long lead times.
map.把到货质量的检测数值（如尺寸、含量）粘贴成数列，统计均值与波动，判断供应商过程能: Paste measured quality values on arrival (such as dimensions or content) as a series, compute the mean and variation, and judge the supplier's process capability.
map.统计一段时间内各供应商的绩效原始数值，形成对比基线，再结合比率类指标做综合评价。: Compile each supplier's raw performance values over a period to form a comparison baseline, then combine them with ratio indicators for an overall assessment.
map.以「8 笔交货周期（天）」为例: Using "8 delivery lead times in days" as an example

map.本工具只做基础描述统计（对输入的数值序列求均值、标准差等），不直接计算准时率或次: This tool only does basic descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, and so on for the entered series) and does not compute on-time or defect rates directly. Compute those percentages yourself as on-time batches over total batches and defects over total, then paste the values in to study their distribution.
